text:
sara: quick heads-up — py-sdk 1.4 will stop auto-injecting route hint headers next Tue. PR landed and packaged. please read before onboarding any new internal proxies.
kevin: wait, does that break our console telemetry linking? we rely on that header to stitch traces to routes.
mina: short answer: yes if you rely on implicit injection. the SDK will still accept explicit headers, but we want clients to opt-in so we can surface per-caller attribution in quota dashboards.
luis: doing that sounds fine, but how will rollout look? we have a bunch of customers using older libs. need a grace window + telemetry fallback in the console.
sara: plan from the PR: 1) release a deprecation warning in 1.3, 2) default-off behavior in 1.4 with migrations docs, 3) a 2-week canary for internal services.
kevin: can we add a console flag that maps legacy automatic headers to the new route meta so dashboards don't split? otherwise we'll see metric churn.
mina: yes — backfill support on the platform side is doable. but it's not free: we need to sample low-cardinality and prioritize team quotas. propose a sampling key: `legacy_route_id` with 1% full fidelity + aggregated counts.
luis: what about quota enforcement? if SDKs stop hinting quota buckets, some requests will land on default bucket and get throttled unexpectedly. need default fallback policy.
sara: default policy = fallback to account-level bucket, not team-level. we'll add a console warning tile for services that trigger fallback more than X/min.
kevin: can we include a quick migration snippet for python and ts in the release notes? a 3-line example will cut the support queue.
mina: yep, suggested snippet in PR doc:```python
# old implicit
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.generate(prompt)

# new explicit route_hint
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.generate(prompt, route_hint={"policy":"latency","quota":"team:acq"})
```
sara: + add the header example for proxy folks: `X-Redwood-Route: policy=latency;quota=team:acq`
luis: for dashboards — ops: can we add a migration view that shows traffic currently relying on implicit injection? a per-service heatmap would help.
kevin: also, console rollout UX: expose a toggle for "treat legacy headers as route-hints" with a note: "temporary — will be retired in 30 days". helps enterprise customers coordinate upgrades.
mina: agree. platform work items: (a) add migration toggle + short TTL, (b) sample legacy keys and aggregate, (c) emit a telemetry marker event when fallback occurs so Eval/Quality teams can track regressions.
sara: ops-bot — can you start a canary deploy for the SDK change to internal staging group alpha-team?
ops-bot: started canary deploy to `staging-alpha` at 2532109975. monitoring hooks: latency, quota-falls, and console-migration-tile.
devex-bot: released py-sdk 1.4rc  — changelog: "explicit route hints; deprecation warnings; migration snippet" — docs PR: /docs/sdk/migrations/route-hint.md
kevin: thanks. i'll coordinate a 48h shadow run with the internal proxy team and report any churn on the dashboard.
mina: if we see >3% fallback rate for a service, auto-open an alert and create a migration task in the console for that owner.
sara: thanks team. i'll follow up with a short playbook and the exact dates. feel free to drop problems here. :thumbsup:
